caption: San Giorgio Cathedral, Modica
composition: Baroque facade above the monumental staircase · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From below, the tourist looks up the monumental staircase climbing to San Giorgio's Baroque facade, which rises on the right with its scrolled gable and cross-topped crown. The long balustraded steps descend through the frame center toward the dense stone houses of Modica Alta piling up the hillside to the left. Bright 08:02 light under broken cloud gives the honey-colored stone a soft glow.
